title: Explain the manual moe-cache-size 4000 vs auto 3978 regression
analysis: s4000 and auto resolve nearly the same residency (miss 0.24 both; 4000 vs 3978 slots), so the 17.52 vs 23.62 gap is NOT a hit-rate effect.

s4000 runs with only 2.16 GiB free after init and via the manual path; auto also enables prefill_overlap. The regression is consistent with VRAM-pressure/allocator+graph effects under the tighter headroom and the absence of the auto overlap path, not with cache capacity.
switching to s3200 (20.28) or auto (23.62) recovers; manual sizes near the edge are not advisable.

decision.reason: prod mode is --moe-cache-auto (adopted 45/49), which resolves the safe size itself; the manual near-edge configuration is not used. Documented, no code change.

limitations: Diagnosed from the 07b sweep; not re-measured after the hybrid adoption.
